name: turkorbit
description: TÜRK ORBIT — turkorbit.com uzay MMO platformu (monorepo)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @turkorbit/api && npm run build -w @turkorbit/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @turkorbit/api && npm run typecheck -w @turkorbit/client
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate -w @turkorbit/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @turkorbit/api
scripts.dev:game: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:game -w @turkorbit/api
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @turkorbit/shared && npm run test -w @turkorbit/api
